laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'bouprojekte ... laat bou' repeats 'bou'; 'laat uitvoer' keeps the causative meaning and the protected 'bouprojekte'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'laat uitvoer' is more abstract and bookish for a Grade 5 reader and does not fit 'tempels en piramides'; the light repetition of 'bou' does not make the original fall short.

laat_vaar.blok: Tussen die gode en die mense
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'gawes' is bookish and can also mean talents; 'geskenke' is clearer for Grade 5 with the same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'gawes aan die gode' is the natural, idiomatic phrase for offerings in a religious context, so swapping it for 'geskenke' is a lateral move that also loses the offering sense.

laat_vaar.voor: Baie mense dink slawe het die piramides gebou
laat_vaar.na: Baie mense dink dat slawe die piramides gebou het
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In written text the full subordinate clause with 'dat' and verb-final word order is the standard, clearer form.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Leaving out 'dat' after 'dink' is standard written Afrikaans and reads well, so the proposal is only a different form and makes the sentence longer.

laat_vaar.voor: Mense in elke groep het die lewe anders beleef.
laat_vaar.na: Elke groep het die lewe anders beleef.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Mense in elke groep ... anders' can read as people within one group differing; the intended contrast is between groups.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original says people in each group lived differently and can carry both senses (between groups and within them), so the proposal narrows the meaning to one of them and makes the subject more abstract.
